easy.def: To have a certain look, place, or feeling.
examples: I am happy today.
The cat is on the bed.
We were at the park.

more.def: To exist, to stay in a place, or to have a certain quality.
examples: The library is next to the school.
Our teacher was late this morning because of the snow.
Whales are the largest animals on Earth.

easy.def: Very nice to look at or hear.
examples: What a beautiful flower!
The sunset is beautiful.
You made a beautiful card.

more.def: Very pleasing to see, hear, or think about.
examples: The beautiful music made everyone stop and listen.
The garden looked beautiful after the roses bloomed.
She has a beautiful singing voice.

easy.def: A word used to give a reason.
examples: I am happy because it is my birthday.
We stayed in because it rained.
She cried because she fell.

more.def: A word used to tell the reason for something.
examples: The ice melted because the sun was so hot.
I wore a sweater because the room was cold.
He could not play because his leg hurt.
Wash up before dinner.
I woke before the sun.
Brush your teeth before bed.

more.def: At an earlier time than something else, or in front of something.
examples: Please finish your homework before you play outside.
The thunder came before the rain.
He arrived at the station before noon.
I have seen it before.
She came the day before.
Have you been here before?

more.def: At some time earlier than now.
examples: I have never ridden a horse before.
We met the new teacher the day before.
Have you tried this fruit before?

easy.def: To think that something is true.
examples: I believe you.
I believe it will snow soon.
Do you believe in fairies?

more.def: To feel sure that something is true or real.
examples: She believed her team could win if they worked together.
Nobody believed him when he said he saw a bear.
I believe that practice will make me a better swimmer.
The cat is beneath the table.
The fish swim beneath the boat.
I hid beneath my blanket.
The treasure was buried beneath an old oak tree.
Worms tunnel beneath the surface of the soil.
We sat beneath a shady tree to eat our lunch.

easy.def: More good than before or than another.
examples: This book is better.
I feel better now.
Her drawing is better than mine.

more.def: Of a higher quality than something else, or in improved health.
examples: Fresh bread is much better than stale bread.
I felt better after I rested for a day.
Practice will make your piano playing better.
I sing better now.
She runs better than me.
Do it better next time.

more.def: In a more skillful or more pleasing way.
examples: My little sister reads better every week.
The plants grow better in the sun than in the shade.
You will do better on the test if you study.
